{{Short description|none}}
The '''2025 Copa Sudamericana final stages''' were played from 15 July to 22 November 2025.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/calendario-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Protegido: Calendario de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 September 2024|access-date=1 November 2024|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lavoz.com.ar/deportes/futbol/conmebol-publico-el-calendario-2025-cuando-arranca-la-copa-libertadores-para-talleres/|title=Conmebol publicó el calendario 2025: cuándo arranca la Copa Libertadores para Talleres|trans-title=Conmebol published the 2025 calendar: when does the Copa Libertadores start for Talleres?|publisher=[[La Voz del Interior]]|date=13 December 2024|access-date=15 December 2024|language=es}}</ref> A total of 24 teams competed in the final stages to decide the champions of the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CS-2025-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Sudamericana Clubs Handbook|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=12 December 2024|access-date=20 December 2024}}</ref> with the final played at [[Estadio Defensores del Chaco]] in [[Asunción]], Paraguay.<ref name="Final venue change">{{cite web |url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/cambio-de-sede-final-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/ |title=Cambio de sede – Final CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025 |trans-title=Venue change – 2025 CONMEBOL Sudamericana Final |publisher=CONMEBOL |language=es |date=11 September 2025 |access-date=11 September 2025}}</ref>

==Qualified teams==
The winners and runners-up of each of the eight groups in the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana group stage|Copa Sudamericana group stage]] as well as the third-placed teams of each of the eight groups in the [[2025 Copa Libertadores group stage|Copa Libertadores group stage]] advanced to the final stages. The eight Copa Sudamericana group runners-up faced the eight Copa Libertadores group third-placed teams in the knockout round play-offs, whilst the eight Copa Sudamericana group winners directly advanced to the round of 16.

===Seeding===
<section begin=Seeding />
For the final stages, the teams were seeded according to their results in the group stage, with the Copa Sudamericana group winners seeded 1–8, the Copa Sudamericana group runners-up seeded 9–16, and the Copa Libertadores group third-placed teams seeded 17–24. For the round of 16 draw, the seeds 1–8 made up Pot 1, and the eight knockout round play-offs winners (seeds 9–24) made up Pot 2, keeping their seed. Teams from the same association may play each other from the knockout round play-offs onwards.

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the knockout round play-offs, the teams play a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the knockout round play-offs, round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie is played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3). If tied on aggregate, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will not be played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).
*The final is played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.6). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] will be played. If still tied after extra time, a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] will be used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.5).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 2 June 2025, 12:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]) at the CONMEBOL headquarters in [[Luque]], Paraguay.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/sorteo-de-octavos-de-final-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Sorteo de Octavos de Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana – 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana Round of 16 draw|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=19 May 2025|access-date=19 May 2025|language=es}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a Copa Sudamericana group winner (Pot 1) and a knockout round play-offs winner (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).<ref name="regulations"/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-para-octavos-de-final-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Pautas de sorteo para Octavos de Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=Draw guidelines for the Round of 16 of the 2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=21 May 2025|access-date=29 May 2025}}</ref><section end=Draw />

==Knockout round play-offs==
===Summary===
The first legs were played on 15–17 July, and the second legs were played on 22–24 July 2025.<ref name="KRPO fixture">{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/fixture-de-los-playoffs-de-octavos-de-final/|title=Fixture de los Playoffs de Octavos de Final|trans-title=Knockout round play-offs schedule|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=3 June 2025|access-date=3 June 2025|language=es}}</ref><ref name="KRPO fixture pdf">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Fixture_Playoffs-de-Octavos_CONMEBOL-Sudamericana-2025_3.06.2025.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2025 {{!}} PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - Playoff de Octavos de Final {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 3.06.2025|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=3 June 2025|access-date=3 June 2025|language=es}}</ref>

==Round of 16==
===Summary===

==Final==
{{main|2025 Copa Sudamericana final}}
The final was played on 22 November 2025 in [[Asunción]], Paraguay. [[Estadio Ramón Tahuichi Aguilera]] in [[Santa Cruz de la Sierra]], Bolivia had been originally selected as the venue for the final,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/asuncion-y-santa-cruz-sedes-confirmadas-para-finales-de-la-conmebol-sudamericana/|title=¡Asunción y Santa Cruz recibirán a la Gran Conquista!|trans-title=Asunción and Santa Cruz will host the Great Conquest!|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=10 April 2024|access-date=15 May 2025|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lostiempos.com/deportes/futbol/20240411/tahuichi-aguilera-recibira-gran-final-copa-sudamericana-2025|title=El Tahuichi Aguilera recibirá la gran final de la Copa Sudamericana de 2025|trans-title=The Tahuichi Aguilera will host the grand final of the 2025 Copa Sudamericana|publisher=[[Los Tiempos]]|date=11 April 2024|access-date=15 May 2025|language=es}}</ref> but CONMEBOL announced the change of venue on 11 September 2025 due to delays in the works to prepare the stadium for the event.<ref name="Final venue change"/>
